description: Resource cost definitions for the Cost-Accounting Ledger. Defines unit costs, starting allocations (for spend tracking — not enforced as limits), material inventories, and per-test costs. Prices are rough-order-of-magnitude (ROM) estimates in 2024-2025 USD.

financial_usd.description: Starting USD allocation for spend tracking. Not enforced as a limit.

labor_person_hours.description: Starting crew person-hours allocation (20 crew x 24 hours). Tracked for reporting, not enforced as a limit.

cash.description: Cash is recorded at face value; the fixed rate is an accounting identity, not an unanchored assumption.

labour_hours.description: Seconded technician-hour value is an unanchored modelling assumption for sensitivity analysis, not a reimbursement rate.

consumables.description: Reagent and consumable supply value is an unanchored modelling assumption for sensitivity analysis, not a procurement price.

rdt_kits.description: Rapid diagnostic test kits (lateral flow antigen). ROM $5-15/test.

pcr_kits.description: qPCR reagent kits for clinical and environmental testing. ROM $30-60/rxn.

swab_kits.description: Surface and patient swab collection kits (swab + transport medium + tube).

meal_trays.description: Individual meal trays for isolation feeding.

culture_media_sets.description: Clinical microbiology culture media set (blood agar plate + MacConkey or chocolate agar + broth). ROM $6-10/set.

air_sniffer_cartridges.description: Bioaerosol sampler filter cartridges (e.g., Thermo AerosolSense cartridge). ROM $50-75/cartridge.

wastewater_collection_kits.description: Wastewater composite sample collection kits (autosampler bottles, preservative, shipping container). ROM $10-20/kit.

library_prep_kits.description: NGS library preparation reagents per reaction (e.g., Illumina DNA Prep ~$23/rxn). Covers tagmentation/amplification reagents and index adapters.

sequencing_flow_cells.description: Sequencing flow cells. ROM covers ONT MinION R10.4.1 ($630-840/cell) or Illumina MiSeq v3 reagent kit. Blended ROM ~$900.

multiplex_panel_kits.description: Multiplex rapid diagnostic panel kits (e.g. BioFire FilmArray GI). ROM $35-50/test.

baseline_surveillance_costs_per_epoch.description: Fixed surveillance costs incurred every epoch regardless of protocol activation. Covers routine environmental swab + qPCR check.

clinical_rdt.description: Point-of-care rapid diagnostic test (lateral flow antigen). ROM $5-15 per test.

clinical_multiplex_panel.description: Multiplex rapid GI panel (e.g. BioFire FilmArray). ROM $35-50 per test.

clinical_impression.description: Bedside clinical impression / NP evaluation without laboratory confirmation.

clinical_qpcr.description: Clinical qPCR assay including sample collection, nucleic acid extraction, and RT-qPCR. ROM $40-100.

clinical_microbiology.description: Clinical microbiology culture including inoculation, incubation (24-48h), colony identification, and basic susceptibility. ROM $30-70.

surface_swab.description: Environmental surface swab with culture-based analysis. Quick collection, minimal lab processing.

surface_swab_culture.description: Environmental surface swab with culture-based analysis. ROM $8-15.

surface_swab_pcr.description: Targeted environmental surface swab with qPCR analysis. ROM $40-70.

air_sniffer_sample.description: Continuous bioaerosol sampler filter collection and downstream qPCR analysis. ROM $50-100.

wastewater_sequencing_panel.description: Wastewater-based epidemiology sequencing panel targeting viral/pathogen markers. ROM $150-500/sample.

long_read_verification.description: Oxford Nanopore long-read escalation for verification/typing (framework placeholder; configure externally).

clinical_strain_typing.description: Clinical amplicon strain typing (Nanopore) for variant surveillance. Default financial cost; a pathogen profile's sequencing_assay.cost_usd overrides it per specimen. ROM $100-300/specimen.

metagenomic_shotgun_sequencing.description: Full metagenomic shotgun sequencing per sample (Illumina or Nanopore). ROM $100-475/sample.

amplicon_16s_sequencing.description: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing per sample. ROM $45-100/sample.

oura_ring.description: Oura Ring Gen3 with health monitoring subscription

garmin_watch.description: Garmin Venu 3 fitness watch, no subscription

cgm_patch.description: Continuous glucose monitor patch (Abbott FreeStyle Libre)
